status: owner-approved definitions for new codes; existing codes are defined by config/account_mappings.json
spelling_convention: British spelling, as in the existing code depreciation_amortisation

cfi.definition: Net cash flow from investing activities for the period, signed (outflows negative).

cff.definition: Net cash flow from financing activities for the period, signed (outflows negative).

net_change_in_cash.definition: Net change in cash and cash equivalents during the period, signed. Equals operating + investing + financing before any exchange effect.

cash_opening.definition: Cash and cash equivalents at the beginning of the cash-flow period, as stated in the cash-flow statement.

cash_closing.definition: Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the cash-flow period, as stated in the cash-flow statement. NOT the balance-sheet cash line (cash_and_equivalents), which the statements report separately.

cash_generated_from_operations.definition: Cash generated from operations before the cash payments of tax, royalty and similar items, as defined by the source statement.

income_tax_paid.definition: Actual cash income tax paid in the period. Not income-tax expense (taxation).

other_income.definition: An other-income line that the source reports explicitly as other income. Never a catch-all for unidentified income; combined lines such as 'finance and other income' are not mapped to it.

amortisation_expense.definition: Amortisation charge (non-cash add-back) reported explicitly as amortisation. Not combined depreciation and amortisation unless the source reports both.
